authority: Generated projection of the maintainer coverage count. Proof authority stays with the Lean source checked by the pinned kernel, and docs/claims.json owns claim status. Each row records which Lean declarations state one asserting paper environment and how far the row has travelled toward independent Comparator replay and Palomar preparation.
row_rule: One row per closed asserting theorem-like environment (and per registered labelled claim span) of the sixteen problem papers, short and long counted separately even when their statements agree. statement_sha256 is the sha256 of the environment body after TeX comments are removed; source is the authored file and line of its opening.

status_rule.lean: exact and exact_or_stronger: the named declarations jointly state the result, the second implying it by an immediate specialisation. modulo_named_input: they state it under the named Lean propositions. none: no Lean statement is recorded; counted false marks a statement the maintainer count has not read yet.
status_rule.comparator: compared: an independent Comparator replay in the corpus repository checked every named declaration (entries, run ids and corpus commits recorded). pending: exact Lean evidence waiting on that replay; queued_at is the date the row entered the worklist. not_applicable: no exact Lean statement.
status_rule.palomar: prepared: the compared corpus entry is in the prepare-only Palomar corpus; submission and acceptance are operator decisions recorded elsewhere. pending: waiting on Comparator. not_applicable: no exact Lean statement.

lean_pin_rule: Every declaration resolves to exactly one declaration line in its file at lean_pin, the release formal-source checkpoint.
